title: Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Program Lead, MALPB
description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Stripe MALPB operates in a complex, fast-moving regulatory environment. The Risk and Compliance team is responsible for ensuring that our expansion is grounded in a bulletproof governance framework that matches the speed of our technology. Having successfully established our foundational ERM policies, taxonomy, and risk registers, we are entering the integration phase. This team is building the future of "AI-Native" risk management—where governance frameworks are embedded into daily business operations through automated data pipelines and LLM orchestration. What you’ll do We are seeking a risk professional who combines strong enterprise risk management (ERM) experience with an analytical mindset and an interest in technology. Grounded in risk, audit, or compliance, you’ll help strengthen risk management across Stripe MALPB by bringing  independent judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and clear communication to complex business challenges. ERM expertise is the primary focus, complemented by SQL skills and curiosity about how AI and automation can improve risk and control processes. We are looking for a rare breed of professional: someone with the executive presence to stand up a banking governance program, combined with the hands-on engineering capabilities to automate it themselves.   As Enterprise Risk Management Lead, you will lead MALPB’s ERM program end-to-end, translating its established framework into consistent practices across the bank. You will provide independent second-line oversight and challenge, deliver clear reporting to management and the Board, and improve how the bank identifies, assesses, monitors, and responds to risk. Responsibilities Lead risk assessments. Run the annual Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) cycle, providing independent second-line challenge of first-line risk assessments, risk ratings, and control effectiveness. Maintain core risk infrastructure. Maintain the Master Control Library, Central Risk Register, and enterprise risk taxonomy, with effective version control and change management to reflect evolving operations and emerging risks. Monitor risk appetite and remediation. Aggregate, analyze, and validate Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) against Board-approved risk appetite thresholds. Escalate breaches, require appropriate Management Action Plans (MAPs), and track remediation. Deliver decision-ready reporting. Combine quantitative risk metrics with qualitative assessments of emerging risks to produce the quarterly Enterprise Risk Scorecard and present clear, actionable insights to the Management Risk Committee and Board of Directors. Apply data-driven analysis. Use basic SQL queries and existing reporting tools to extract and sample data for control verification, partnering with technical teams on more complex analysis, automation, and system integrations. Use AI to improve execution. Explore and apply AI tools to support control monitoring and testing, partnering with technical teams to develop agents that flag potential anomalies or control deficiencies for expert review. Advance continuous monitoring. Progressively supplement point-in-time testing with automated dashboards and ongoing monitoring of key operational and regulatory controls. Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.  Minimum requirements 8+ years of experience in enterprise risk management, operational risk, or risk advisory within a regulated financial institution, fintech company, or Big Four technology-risk practice. Demonstrated experience implementing and embedding ERM programs—including RCSAs, KRIs, risk registers, and control libraries—within active, fast-paced business operations. Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret large datasets, assess data quality, and translate findings into meaningful risk insights. Working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to write basic queries for data extraction and analysis. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience constructively challenging senior business leaders and preparing concise, Board-level risk reporting. Familiarity with AI tools and a willingness to learn how to build and apply AI agents to risk management processes. Preferred qualifications Experience in a regula

title: Senior Manager, Security Governance, Risk and Compliance
description: Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.  At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.  A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. About the role Roblox is looking for a Senior Manager of Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) to own how we identify, quantify, and govern security risk across the company. This is a risk-first role: our primary focus is identifying and managing risk, and that focus is what enables us to meet our compliance obligations. You will lead the GRC team and be accountable for Roblox’s security risk posture, from the methodology we use to rate risk, to the Top Risks we report on, to the decisions leaders make because of what we show them. Our program takes a balanced, “right-sized” approach, combining qualitative and quantitative methods, including Factor Analysis of Information Risk (FAIR), to focus the company on the risks that matter most. We use engineering to automate risk management, supply chain risk, AI risk, and controls monitoring, so that we mitigate risk with code rather than compliance checklists. You will be a key member of the InfoSec leadership team, helping set security priorities for Roblox. You will own security risk reporting to the Board of Directors’ Audit & Compliance Committee and executive leadership, and work with Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Finance, and the business to reduce risk without slowing Roblox down. This position is part of the Information Security team. This role will report to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). You will: Own Roblox’s security risk management program end to end, including the risk methodology, Top Risks, the risk register, the semi-annual risk refresh, and the risk exception and acceptance process. Be accountable for Top Risks: drive mitigation plans with Security, Engineering, and Infrastructure leaders, track progress to target residual risk, and escalate when risk falls outside tolerance. Own security risk reporting to the Board’s Audit & Compliance Committee and executive leadership, using quantified risk analysis and indicators to give leaders a clear, decision-ready view of our posture. Assess and guide risk in the areas moving fastest for Roblox, such as AI and agentic tooling, third-party and supply chain, new products, and global expansion, acting as a partner who gets to “here is the path forward with these controls” rather than a gate. Build, lead, and develop the GRC team, and invest in GRC engineering and automation that makes risk visible and measurable in near real time. Lead cross-functional risk governance with Security, Legal, Privacy, Engineering, and Finance, and use our risk-based approach to meet regulatory, policy, and audit obligations, keeping standards and controls aligned to the risks we have prioritized. You have: 12+ years of experience in security risk management, GRC, or technology risk, including 4+ years leading and developing teams. Experience owning an enterprise security risk program, including risk assessment methodology, a risk register, risk acceptance, and tracking mitigation to closure. Hands-on experience with quantitative risk analysis (FAIR or similar) alongside qualitative methods, and the ability to translate both into business impact and tradeoffs. Experience presenting risk to senior executives and boards, with the judgment to take a clear position under pressure. Credibility with engineers and a strong understanding of modern technology environments, including cloud and AI systems. Writing code is not required. Preferred: familiarity with security and regulatory frameworks (such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIS2) and experience using automation or AI to scale GRC programs. You are: Risk-first and pragmatic: you right-size controls to the risk, and you see security as a way to help the business move faster safely. Decisive and direct: you are comfortable saying “not yet” and “here is how we get to yes,” and you hold the line on risk acceptance. A leader who sets direction: you drive the agenda in senior cross-functional forums, not just report into them. A coach and builder: you grow your people, give them real ownership, and push your team toward automation. title: Internal Controls & Audit - Assistant Vice President

The individual will demonstrate the ability to independently apply the department’s audit methodology. They will participate in all phases of the audit from planning to reporting, including understanding business operations, scoping the audit, identifying risks and controls, designing and executing testing with minimal oversight and assisting with the writing of audit reports This position will collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to drive audit excellence and a strong control environment. They will possess the ability to perform assessments of IT General Controls and prepare appropriate working papers, including gathering information around understanding the IT environmental and requesting data to support these activities and assist in the Third-Party Vendor audit reports reviews. Control Testing: Perform control testing across financial, operational, and IT domains, including walkthroughs, re-performance, inspection, and observation techniques. Control Findings: Review and evaluate evidence to identify control deficiencies and recommend remediation strategies. Control Management: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address audit findings and implement corrective actions. Third Party Review: Perform vendor risk assessments and review third-party control reports from an IT risk standpoint. GRC Tool: Support the development and enhancement of reporting tools and dashboards Issue Tracking: Develop and implement mechanisms for issue, complaint, and incident reporting to identify errors and remediate root causes. Compliance: Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices related to audit. Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Accounting, Finance, Cybersecurity, Internal Audit or related discipline. Experience : 6+ years of experience in IT audit, internal audit, IT risk, compliance or information security. Presence: Strong work ethic, resourceful disposition, and solutions-oriented mindset with interpersonal skills that enhance partner capacity. Attributes: Adaptable and entrepreneurial; a willingness to roll up sleeves and get stuff done. Skill: Exceptional organizational, time management, and written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in audit management software (e.g., ACL, IDEA) and Microsoft Office Suite Knowledge: Strong understanding of audit and control frameworks, operational risk assessment methodologies, and industry regulatory compliance requirements. Experience: Experience with IT General Controls with regards to Logical Access, Change Management, IT Operations testing.   We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office four days, with the flexibility to work remotely one day (Friday).   Benefits iCapital offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes a total compensation program consisting of competitive salary, annual performance bonus, and equity for all full-time employees; healthcare with 100% employer-paid health and dental insurance; and generous paid time off (PTO). title: Manager, Business Risk and AI Automation

Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . Position Overview We're seeking a Manager, Business Risk and AI Automation, to help shape the next chapter of Internal Audit at Reddit. You'll lead day-to-day oversight and hands-on execution of our SOX program across Business Process Controls, Entity Level Controls, Key Reports, and Tech Application Controls, while helping build an AI-first approach to assurance. As part of our Risk Advisory and Assurance team, you'll tackle complex control questions and turn emerging technology into practical improvements. You’ll have opportunities to apply your expertise more broadly to strengthen internal controls and improve processes across the business. This is an opportunity for a strong internal controls practitioner who enjoys owning delivery and building better ways to work. This is an individual contributor role . The Manager owns SOX program delivery and partners with a Senior teammate who performs business process testing, providing review, technical guidance, and cross-functional coordination. What You’ll Do Own day-to-day SOX delivery from risk assessment and scoping through testing and reporting, keeping the program on track and focused on key risks. Lead walkthroughs and hands-on testing of control design and operating effectiveness across business process controls, entity level controls, key reports, and technology application controls. Ensure high-quality, well-supported SOX testing through workpaper review, actionable feedback, and technical guidance to other team members. Evaluate testing exceptions, support deficiency assessment, and coordinate remediation tracking and retesting to confirm control issues are resolved. Build repeatable AI-enabled workflows, validate their accuracy, and help the team adopt them through clear documentation and coaching. A trusted partner who builds strong relationships with business stakeholders and external auditors, communicates findings constructively, and works through complex control judgments. Strong knowledge of SOX and COSO, including risk-based scoping, walkthroughs, control design and operating effectiveness testing, evidence evaluation, and deficiency assessment. Strong project management, workpaper review, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex processes and risks into clear conclusions and practical recommendations. Hands-on experience using AI tools and prompting to improve professional workflows, with the ability to test, refine, and critically evaluate results. You possess strong technical depth across large-scale data processing pipelines, storage architectures, cloud platform services, and high-availability enterprise environments. You have hands-on or strategic experience operationalizing AI/ML developer workflows, LLM infrastructure, or agentic developer tools. title: Technical Program Manager II

At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the  flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here . The Team Pinterest is a visual discovery platform where people go from inspiration to action, and our infrastructure organization plays a foundational role in making that possible at scale. This team focuses on capacity planning and infrastructure efficiency — helping engineering partners understand what they're using, plan ahead for growth, and reduce waste. What You'll Do Partner with an assigned engineering domain to support capacity planning: tracking current usage, near-term demand, and headroom against agreed targets. Help run the operating cadence for capacity and efficiency programs — status updates, milestone tracking, risk/action logs, and business reviews — using established templates and frameworks. Build and maintain dashboards and trackers that make utilization, capacity headroom, and efficiency opportunities visible to engineering and TPM leadership. Work with engineers to identify and help drive efficiency opportunities (right-sizing, decommissioning idle resources, improving utilization) under the guidance of senior TPMs. Support the team's forecasting inputs, working from established models rather than building new financial or cost models independently. Document and maintain playbooks and process guides so capacity and efficiency mechanisms are clear, consistent, and easy to hand off. Communicate clearly with engineering partners and your manager or lead TPM; flag risks and escalate blockers early. Use GenAI as the default operating model for EP PgM execution—producing AI-assisted first drafts of core program artifacts, modernizing high-toil workflows into AI-first mechanisms (e.g., intake triage, status synthesis, action/decision extraction, risk & dependency tracking), and synthesizing signals to proactively surface risks, decision/trade-offs, and escalation paths. title: Associate Manager, SOX and Internal Controls
description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  Learn more about working at Coinbase . About the team The Finance Controls team helps management establish and maintain effective internal controls over financial reporting. We partner closely with control owners, Finance and Accounting leaders, Internal Audit, external auditors, Technology and Security teams, Legal, Compliance, and other cross-functional partners to strengthen the control environment and support reliable financial reporting. As an Associate Manager, SOX & Internal Controls, you'll own a defined set of business processes within Coinbase's SOX and SOC 1 programs from end to end. Our Internal Controls team keeps Coinbase audit-ready by designing, documenting, and monitoring the controls that safeguard financial reporting across a fast-changing crypto platform. You'll bring a technology lens to controls work, mapping data flows from source systems to financial statements, evaluating automated control evidence, and driving remediation when gaps arise. What you'll do: Own assigned SOX business processes end to end, including process narratives, risk-and-control matrices, key systems, automated controls, and business process controls, keeping each area audit-ready through continuous documentation and design updates. Partner with Technology, Engineering, Security Compliance, and Finance Analytics to scope IT general controls and IT application controls, map data flows, and evaluate the reliability of system-generated evidence. Lead day-to-day SOX and SOC 1 execution for your area, including risk assessment, scoping, walkthroughs, testing coordination, deficiency evaluation, and remediation tracking with control owners. Coordinate audit readiness and information requests with Internal Audit and external auditors, ensuring support is timely, complete, and well organized. Advise control owners on control design, evidence quality, and sustainable remediation while helping improve repeatable standards, playbooks, and evidence workflows across the function. Required Skills and Experience: 6+ years in SOX, IT audit, internal controls, controllership, or a closely related controls function, with Big Four or public accounting experience preferred. Demonstrated ownership of a business process or controls workstream end to end, from documentation through testing and remediation, in a heavily automated, high-change environment. Working knowledge of ITGCs (access, change management, operations), IT application controls, and system-generated reports, with the ability to trace how a system supports a financial process. Hands-on experience with data validation across systems using SQL, spreadsheets, or analytics tools to test control logic and verify system output. CPA, CISA, CIA, or comparable certification preferred; Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). title: Principal Security GRC Analyst
description: Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.  At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.  A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. About the role: As a member of the Roblox Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team, you will play a key role in supporting the Security team’s mission. The GRC team is at the heart of Roblox's security organization — empowering every builder to make risk-informed decisions by establishing a portfolio of governing policies and standards, a repeatable and scalable method of assessing and quantifying risk, and a formal oversight process for GRC capabilities across Roblox. Our program takes a balanced, "right-sized" approach to security governance — combining qualitative and quantitative risk management methodologies, including Factor Analysis of Information Risk (FAIR), to assess and prioritize the security risks that matter most to Roblox. GRC partners closely with Engineering, Legal, Finance, and leadership — including providing regular reporting to the Board of Directors and the Audit & Compliance Committee — to ensure that security risk is visible, well-understood, and actioned appropriately. The team is in an exciting phase of growth and innovation. We are using engineering to drive automation across risk management, policy lifecycle management, supply chain risk, AI risk, and controls programs. You will have the opportunity to shape how GRC operates at scale and contribute to a collaborative, high-performing team culture that supports Roblox and the broader security organization. This position is part of the Information Security team. This role will report to the GRC Manager. You will: You will lead one or more program areas in our Governance, Risk, and Compliance team You will be a key contributor to the larger Information Security Organization. You will partner with your GRC, Infosec and Engineering colleagues and support the design and implementation of a “risk first”  governance function that is “right-sized” for Roblox. You will identify opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness, designing tools and automations along the way to drive security and compliance by design. You will write, revise, and manage our information security policies, standards, and procedures. You will identify and assess information security risks. You will work with Information Security and Engineering colleagues to implement appropriate controls to mitigate identified risks. You will validate control design and effectiveness. You will support ongoing risk monitoring and reporting. You will be a subject matter expert in the GRC space, providing education and guidance to others across the Roblox organization. You will be a part of the Roblox community, living our values and securing the metaverse. You have: 10+ years of relevant professional experience in Security Governance, Risk and Compliance. Experience interfacing with software engineers to identify risks, map commitments to controls and develop relevant policies.  Experience assessing adherence to policies and developing mitigation and remediation plans when gaps exist. Deep understanding of risk assessment, compliance frameworks, creation of policy, and how to educate organizations on these concepts.      Understanding of security concepts and a broad range of security risks and controls. Experience in tech; however the need to actively code is not required for the role, just the ability to interface with Engineers and quickly establish credibility.  For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page .
